title: Historical Urban Population 3700 BC – AD 2000 (Reba, Reitsma & Seto; geocoded Chandler 1987 and Modelski 2003 estimates; SEDAC/Harvard Dataverse)
describe: Cities of the world with the population estimates of Tertius Chandler's Four Thousand Years of Urban Growth (1987) and George Modelski's World Cities (2003), geocoded by Reba, Reitsma & Seto (2016). Each estimate is shown in its own year only; nothing is interpolated between estimates. Positions the authors rank least certain (rank 3) are marked approximate.
